## What this adds or changes

A recipe, a fix to a recipe, or a change to the skill. One thing per pull request.

## Where the method comes from

Links to the sources (use commit permalinks), and the people or projects to credit.

## How you proved it

Counts or an example. For a move to `tested`, the counts from your own run.

## AI assistance

Model and harness (for example, "Claude Opus 5.5 in Claude Code"), or "written by hand".

## Checklist

- [ ] All template sections are present, and `python scripts/check_recipes.py` passes.
- [ ] It is written in my own words, and the source is credited.
- [ ] It adds no third-party files (binaries, samples, keys, firmware, game files).
- [ ] No step downloads and runs code without explaining why.
